scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@bytehub/api run test && npm --workspace=@bytehub/shared run test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=@bytehub/web run lint && npm --workspace=@bytehub/api run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@bytehub/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@bytehub/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@bytehub/web run typecheck
